title: GS-Playground: A High-Throughput Photorealistic Simulator for Vision-Informed Robot Learning
summary: Embodied AI research is undergoing a shift toward vision-centric perceptual paradigms. While massively parallel simulators have catalyzed breakthroughs in proprioception-based locomotion, their potential remains largely untapped for vision-informed tasks due to the prohibitive computational overhead of large-scale photorealistic rendering. Furthermore, the creation of simulation-ready 3D assets heavily relies on labor-intensive manual modeling, while the significant sim-to-real physical gap hinders the transfer of contact-rich manipulation policies. To address these bottlenecks, we propose GS-Playground, a multi-modal simulation framework designed to accelerate end-to-end perceptual learning. We develop a novel high-performance parallel physics engine, specifically designed to integrate with a batch 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) rendering pipeline to ensure high-fidelity synchronization. Our system achieves a breakthrough throughput of 10^4 FPS at 640x480 resolution, significantly lowering the barrier for large-scale visual RL. Additionally, we introduce an automated Real2Sim workflow that reconstructs photorealistic, physically consistent, and memory-efficient environments, streamlining the generation of complex simulation-ready scenes. Extensive experiments on locomotion, navigation, and manipulation demonstrate that GS-Playground effectively bridges the perceptual and physical gaps across diverse embodied tasks. Project homepage: https://gsplayground.github.io.
tldr: Proposes GS-Playground, a high-throughput photorealistic simulator using 3D Gaussian Splatting for vision-informed embodied AI tasks, aiming to accelerate visual RL and bridge sim-to-real gaps.
tldr_zh: 提出GS-Playground，一个利用3D高斯泼溅技术的高通量、逼真模拟器，用于视觉信息化的具身AI任务，旨在加速视觉强化学习并弥合仿真到现实的鸿沟。
summary_zh: 具身人工智能研究正朝着以视觉为中心的感知范式转变。尽管大规模并行仿真器已在基于本体感知的运动控制领域取得突破性进展，但受制于大规模高真实感渲染的惊人计算开销，其在视觉感知任务中的潜力仍远未得到充分挖掘。此外，仿真就绪的三维资产创建高度依赖劳动密集的手工建模，而显著的仿真与现实间物理差异进一步阻碍了密集接触式操作策略的迁移应用。为突破这些瓶颈，我们提出了GS-Playground——一个旨在加速端到端感知学习的多模态仿真框架。我们研发了新型高性能并行物理引擎，专门设计用于与批量三维高斯溅射渲染管线集成，确保实现高保真度的物理视觉同步。该系统在640x480分辨率下实现了10^4 FPS的突破性吞吐量，显著降低了大规模视觉强化学习的应用门槛。此外，我们引入了自动化Real2Sim工作流，可重建具备高真实感、物理一致性与内存高效性的三维环境，大幅简化了复杂仿真场景的生成流程。通过在运动控制、导航与操作任务上的大量实验验证，GS-Playground有效弥合了多种具身任务中的感知与物理差异。项目主页：https://gsplayground.github.io。

title: HANDFUL: Sequential Grasp-Conditioned Dexterous Manipulation with Resource Awareness
summary: Dexterous robot hands offer rich opportunities for multifunctional manipulation, where a robot must execute multiple skills in sequence while maintaining control over previously grasped objects. Most prior work in dexterous manipulation focuses on single-object, single-skill tasks. In contrast, our insight is that many sequential tasks require resource-aware grasps that conserve fingers for future actions. In this paper, we study sequential grasp-conditioned dexterous manipulation, where a robot first grasps an object and then performs a second, distinct manipulation subtask while preserving the initial grasp. We introduce HANDFUL, a learning framework that models finger usage as a limited resource and encourages exploration of resource-aware grasps through finger-level contact rewards. These grasps are subsequently selected for downstream tasks via curriculum-based policy learning. We further propose HANDFUL-Bench, a simulation benchmark that introduces sequential dexterous manipulation tasks across multiple secondsubtask objectives, including pushing, pulling, and pressing, under a shared grasp-conditioned setup. Extensive simulation results demonstrate that prioritizing resource-aware grasps improves second-subtask success and robustness compared to a baseline that greedily optimizes the initial grasp before attempting the second subtask. We additionally validate our approach on a real dexterous LEAP hand. Together, this work establishes resource-aware grasp planning as a key principle for multifunctional dexterous manipulation. Supplementary material is available on our website: https://handful-dex.github.io.
tldr: This paper introduces HANDFUL, a learning framework for sequential dexterous manipulation where a robot performs a second subtask while maintaining a grasp on a first object, modeling finger usage as a resource to encourage resource-aware grasps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出HANDFUL学习框架，用于机器人连续灵巧操作，即在保持初始抓握的同时执行第二个子任务，将手指使用建模为有限资源以鼓励资源感知的抓取。
summary_zh: 灵巧机器人手为多功能操作提供了丰富的可能性，机器人需在持续控制已抓取物体的前提下按顺序执行多项技能。现有灵巧操作研究大多聚焦于单一物体、单一技能的任务。与此不同，我们的核心观点是：许多顺序任务需要资源感知的抓取方式，即为后续动作保留可用手指。本文研究了顺序抓取条件下的灵巧操作范式——机器人首先抓取物体，随后在保持初始抓取的同时执行第二个独立操作子任务。我们提出了HANDFUL学习框架，该框架将手指使用建模为有限资源，并通过手指级接触奖励机制促进资源感知抓取方式的探索。这些抓取策略随后通过课程式策略学习被筛选用于下游任务。我们进一步提出了HANDFUL-Bench仿真基准，在共享的抓取条件设置下构建了涵盖推动、拉拽、按压等多种第二子任务目标的顺序灵巧操作任务集。大量仿真实验表明，相较于在尝试第二子任务前贪婪优化初始抓取的基线方法，优先考虑资源感知抓取能显著提升第二子任务的成功率与鲁棒性。我们还在真实LEAP灵巧手上验证了该方法的有效性。本工作共同确立了资源感知抓取规划作为多功能灵巧操作的关键原则。补充材料详见项目网站：https://handful-dex.github.io。

title: Libra-VLA: Achieving Learning Equilibrium via Asynchronous Coarse-to-Fine Dual-System
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a promising paradigm for generalist robotic manipulation by grounding high-level semantic instructions into executable physical actions. However, prevailing approaches typically adopt a monolithic generation paradigm, directly mapping visual-linguistic features to high-frequency motor commands in a flat, non-hierarchical fashion. This strategy overlooks the inherent hierarchy of robotic manipulation, where complex actions can be naturally modeled in a Hybrid Action Space, decomposing into discrete macro-directional reaching and continuous micro-pose alignment, severely widening the semantic-actuation gap and imposing a heavy representational burden on grounding high-level semantics to continuous actions. To address this, we introduce Libra-VLA, a novel Coarse-to-Fine Dual-System VLA architecture. We explicitly decouple the learning complexity into a coarse-to-fine hierarchy to strike a training equilibrium, while simultaneously leveraging this structural modularity to implement an asynchronous execution strategy. The Semantic Planner predicts discrete action tokens capturing macro-directional intent, while the Action Refiner conditions on coarse intent to generate high-frequency continuous actions for precise alignment. Crucially, our empirical analysis reveals that performance follows an inverted-U curve relative to action decomposition granularity, peaking exactly when the learning difficulty is balanced between the two sub-systems. With the asynchronous design, our approach offers a scalable, robust, and responsive solution for open-world manipulation.
tldr: Proposes Libra-VLA, a novel coarse-to-fine dual-system VLA architecture for robotic manipulation that uses a Semantic Planner for macro-directional intent and an Action Refiner for high-frequency control, aiming to balance learning complexity via asynchronous execution and optimal action decomposition granularity.
tldr_zh: 提出Libra-VLA，一种用于机器人操作的粗到细双系统VLA架构，通过语义规划器预测宏观意图，动作优化器生成精细控制，利用异步执行和最优动作分解粒度来平衡学习复杂性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过将高层语义指令转化为可执行的物理动作，为实现通用机器人操作提供了一种有前景的范式。然而，现有方法通常采用单一生成范式，以扁平化、非层级的方式直接将视觉-语言特征映射为高频运动指令。这种策略忽略了机器人操作固有的层次性——复杂动作本可在混合动作空间中建模，分解为离散的宏观方向性接近与连续的微观姿态对准两个阶段，而现有方法人为扩大了语义与执行间的鸿沟，并为将高层语义落地到连续动作带来了沉重的表征负担。为此，我们提出Libra-VLA，一种新颖的由粗到精双系统VLA架构。该架构将学习复杂度显式解耦为粗粒度到细粒度的层次结构，以实现训练均衡，同时利用这种结构模块化特性实现异步执行策略：语义规划器预测捕获宏观方向意图的离散动作标记，而动作精炼器则基于粗粒度意图生成高频连续动作以实现精确对准。关键的是，我们的实证分析表明，系统性能与动作分解粒度呈现倒U型曲线关系，且峰值恰好出现在两个子系统学习难度达到平衡时。结合异步设计，本方法为开放世界操作任务提供了可扩展、鲁棒且响应灵敏的解决方案。

title: asRoBallet: Closing the Sim2Real Gap via Friction-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Underactuated Spherical Dynamics
summary: We introduce asRoBallet, to the best of our knowledge, the first successful deployment of reinforcement learning (RL) on a humanoid ballbot hardware. Historically, ballbots have served as a canonical benchmark for underactuated and nonholonomic control, which are characterized by a reality gap in complex friction models for wheel-sphere-ground interactions. While current literature demonstrates successful handling of 3D balancing with LQR and MPC, transitioning to actual hardware for a humanoid ballbot using RL is currently hindered by critical gaps in contact modeling, actuator latency & jitter, and safe hardware exploration, and safe hardware exploration. This study proposes a high-fidelity MuJoCo simulation that explicitly models the discrete roller mechanics of ETH-type omni-wheels, thereby capturing parasitic vibrations and contact discontinuities that are previously ignored. We also developed a Friction-Aware Reinforcement Learning framework that achieves zero-shot Sim2Real transfer by mastering the coupled rolling, lateral, and torsional friction channels at the wheel-sphere and sphere-ground interfaces. We designed asRoBallet through subtractive reconfiguration, repurposing key components from an overconstrained quadruped and integrating them into a newly designed structural frame to achieve a robust research platform at low cost. We also developed a generalized iOS ecosystem that transforms consumer electronics into a low-latency interface, enabling a single operator to orchestrate expressive humanoid maneuvers via intuitive natural motion.
tldr: The paper presents asRoBallet, a reinforcement learning framework for a humanoid ballbot robot, achieving zero-shot sim2real transfer by explicitly modeling friction and contact dynamics in simulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了asRoBallet，一个用于人形球轮机器人的强化学习框架，通过显式模拟摩擦和接触动力学，实现了零样本的仿真到真实迁移。
summary_zh: 我们推出asRoBallet——据我们所知，这是强化学习在类人球形机器人硬件上的首次成功部署。历史上，球形机器人一直是欠驱动与非完整控制领域的经典基准平台，其轮-球-地相互作用中的复杂摩擦模型存在显著的现实差距。当前文献虽已证明可通过LQR和MPC实现三维平衡控制，但将强化学习应用于实际类人球形机器人硬件仍受限于接触建模、执行器延迟与抖动、硬件安全探索等关键难题。本研究提出一种高保真MuJoCo仿真模型，通过显式建模ETH型全向轮的离散滚柱机构，捕捉了以往被忽略的寄生振动与接触间断现象。我们还开发了摩擦感知强化学习框架，通过掌握轮-球与球-地界面的耦合滚动摩擦、侧向摩擦及扭转摩擦通道，实现了零样本仿真到现实的迁移。我们采用减量重构方法设计asRoBallet，复用四足机器人过度约束结构中的关键部件，将其集成至全新设计的结构框架中，以低成本构建了鲁棒的研究平台。同时开发了通用iOS生态系统，将消费电子设备转化为低延迟交互界面，使操作者可通过直观自然动作协调实现富有表现力的类人运动。

title: Variational Neural Belief Parameterizations for Robust Dexterous Grasping under Multimodal Uncertainty
summary: Contact variability, sensing uncertainty, and external disturbances make grasp execution stochastic. Expected-quality objectives ignore tail outcomes and often select grasps that fail under adverse contact realizations. Risk-sensitive POMDPs address this failure mode, but many use particle-filter beliefs that scale poorly, obstruct gradient-based optimization, and estimate Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) with high-variance approximations. We instead formulate grasp acquisition as variational inference over latent contact parameters and object pose, representing the belief with a differentiable Gaussian mixture. We use Gumbel-Softmax component selection and location-scale reparameterization to express samples as smooth functions of the belief parameters, enabling pathwise gradients through a differentiable CVaR surrogate for direct optimization of tail robustness. In simulation, our variational neural belief improves robust grasp success under contact-parameter uncertainty and exogenous force perturbations while reducing planning time by roughly an order of magnitude relative to particle-filter model-predictive control. On a serial-chain robot arm with a multifingered hand, we validate grasp-and-lift success under object-pose uncertainty against a Gaussian baseline. Both methods succeed on the tested perturbations, but our controller terminates in fewer steps and less wall-clock time while achieving a higher tactile grasp-quality proxy. Our learned belief also calibrates risk more accurately, keeping mean absolute calibration error below 0.14 across tested simulation regimes, compared with 0.58 for a Cross-Entropy Method planner.
tldr: This paper introduces a variational neural belief parameterization method for robust dexterous grasping under uncertainty, using a differentiable Gaussian mixture and pathwise gradients to optimize for tail robustness, and demonstrates improved performance in simulation and on a physical robot arm.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于多模态不确定性下稳健灵巧抓取的变分神经信念参数化方法，使用可微分高斯混合和路径梯度来优化尾部鲁棒性，并在模拟和物理机器人上展示了改进的性能。
summary_zh: 接触变异性、感知不确定性和外部扰动使得抓取执行具有随机性。预期质量目标忽略尾部结果，通常会选择在不利接触实现下失败的抓取方案。风险敏感的部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程解决了这一失效模式，但其中许多方法采用粒子滤波器置信度表示，其扩展性较差，阻碍基于梯度的优化，并依赖高方差近似估计条件风险价值。我们提出将抓取获取问题建模为对潜在接触参数和物体姿态的变分推断，使用可微分高斯混合模型表示置信度。通过Gumbel-Softmax分量选择与位置-尺度重参数化技术，我们将采样表达为置信度参数的光滑函数，从而实现对可微分条件风险价值替代函数的路径梯度计算，直接优化尾部鲁棒性。仿真实验表明，我们的变分神经置信度表示在接触参数不确定性和外源力扰动下提升了鲁棒抓取成功率，同时将规划时间较粒子滤波器模型预测控制缩短约一个数量级。在配备多指灵巧手的串联机器人臂上，我们验证了该方法在物体姿态不确定性下抓取-提升任务的成功率，并与高斯基线方法进行对比。两种方法在测试扰动下均能成功完成操作，但我们的控制器以更少的步数和更短的实时计算时间实现任务，同时获得更高的触觉抓取质量代理指标。我们学习的置信度表示还能更精准地校准风险，在测试的仿真场景中保持平均绝对校准误差低于0.14，而交叉熵方法规划器的对应误差为0.58。

title: KinDER: A Physical Reasoning Benchmark for Robot Learning and Planning
summary: Robotic systems that interact with the physical world must reason about kinematic and dynamic constraints imposed by their own embodiment, their environment, and the task at hand. We introduce KinDER, a benchmark for Kinematic and Dynamic Embodied Reasoning that targets physical reasoning challenges arising in robot learning and planning. KinDER comprises 25 procedurally generated environments, a Gymnasium-compatible Python library with parameterized skills and demonstrations, and a standardized evaluation suite with 13 implemented baselines spanning task and motion planning, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and foundation-model-based approaches. The environments are designed to isolate five core physical reasoning challenges: basic spatial relations, nonprehensile multi-object manipulation, tool use, combinatorial geometric constraints, and dynamic constraints, disentangled from perception, language understanding, and application-specific complexity. Empirical evaluation shows that existing methods struggle to solve many of the environments, indicating substantial gaps in current approaches to physical reasoning. We additionally include real-to-sim-to-real experiments on a mobile manipulator to assess the correspondence between simulation and real-world physical interaction. KinDER is fully open-sourced and intended to enable systematic comparison across diverse paradigms for advancing physical reasoning in robotics. Website and code: https://prpl-group.com/kinder-site/
tldr: Presents a physical reasoning benchmark for robot learning and planning called KinDER, featuring procedurally generated environments, standardized evaluation, and baselines to evaluate core physical reasoning challenges.
tldr_zh: 提出一个用于机器人学习和规划的物理推理基准KinDER，包含程序化生成的环境、标准化评估和基准方法，用于评估核心物理推理挑战。
summary_zh: 与现实世界交互的机器人系统必须考虑其自身具身结构、所处环境以及当前任务所施加的运动学与动力学约束。本文提出KinDER基准测试平台，用于评估运动学与动力学具身推理能力，旨在解决机器人学习与规划中出现的物理推理挑战。KinDER包含25个程序生成的环境、兼容Gymnasium的Python库（内含参数化技能与演示示例），以及标准化评估套件（涵盖任务运动规划、模仿学习、强化学习和基于基础模型方法的13个基线实现）。该平台通过环境设计分离出五大核心物理推理挑战：基础空间关系、非抓取式多物体操作、工具使用、组合几何约束与动态约束，使其独立于感知、语言理解和特定应用复杂性。实证评估表明，现有方法在多数环境中表现不佳，揭示了当前物理推理方法存在显著不足。我们还通过移动机械臂的实景-仿真-实景实验，评估仿真与真实世界物理交互的对应关系。KinDER平台完全开源，旨在通过系统化跨范式比较推动机器人物理推理研究。项目网站与代码：https://prpl-group.com/kinder-site/

title: Reference-Augmented Learning for Precise Tracking Policy of Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
summary: Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots (TDCRs) pose significant control challenges due to their highly nonlinear, path-dependent dynamics and non-Markovian characteristics. Traditional Jacobian-based controllers often struggle with hysteresis-induced oscillations, while conventional learning-based approaches suffer from poor generalization to out-of-distribution trajectories. This paper proposes a reference-augmented offline learning framework for precise 6-DOF tracking control of TDCRs. By leveraging a differentiable RNN-based dynamics surrogate as a gradient bridge, we optimize a control policy through an augmented reference distribution. This multi-scale augmentation scheme incorporates stochastic bias, harmonic perturbations, and random walks, forcing the policy to internalize diverse tracking error recovery mechanisms without additional hardware interaction. Experimental results on a three-section TDCR platform demonstrate that the proposed policy achieves a 50.9\% reduction in average position error compared to non-augmented baselines and significantly outperforms Jacobian-based methods in both precision and stability across various speeds.
tldr: This paper proposes a reference-augmented offline learning framework for precise 6-DOF tracking control of Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots, using a differentiable RNN-based dynamics surrogate and multi-scale augmentation to significantly reduce position error.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种参考增强的离线学习框架，用于肌腱驱动连续体机器人的精确6-DOF跟踪控制，通过使用可微分RNN动力学代理和多尺度增强，显著降低了位置误差。
summary_zh: 腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCRs）由于其高度非线性、路径依赖的动力学特性以及非马尔可夫特性，在控制上面临重大挑战。传统的基于雅可比矩阵的控制器常因迟滞引发的振荡而难以稳定控制，而常规基于学习的方法则难以泛化到分布外轨迹。本文提出了一种参考增强的离线学习框架，用于实现TDCRs的精确六自由度跟踪控制。通过使用基于可微分循环神经网络的动力学替代模型作为梯度桥梁，我们借助增强的参考分布优化了控制策略。该多尺度增强方案融合了随机偏置、谐波扰动和随机游走，迫使策略在不依赖额外硬件交互的情况下内化多种跟踪误差恢复机制。在三段式TDCR平台上进行的实验结果表明，所提出的策略相较于未增强基线实现了平均位置误差降低50.9%，并在不同速度下均显著优于基于雅可比矩阵的方法，在精度和稳定性方面均表现突出。

title: Learning-Based Dynamics Modeling and Robust Control for Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
summary: Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots (TDCRs) pose significant modeling and control challenges due to complex nonlinearities, such as frictional hysteresis and transmission compliance. This paper proposes a differentiable learning framework that integrates high-fidelity dynamics modeling with robust neural control. We develop a GRU-based dynamics model featuring bidirectional multi-channel connectivity and residual prediction to effectively suppress compounding errors during long-horizon auto-regressive prediction. By treating this model as a gradient bridge, an end-to-end neural control policy is optimized through backpropagation, allowing it to implicitly internalize compensation for intricate nonlinearities. Experimental validation on a physical three-section TDCR demonstrates that our framework achieves accurate tracking and superior robustness against unseen payloads, outperforming Jacobian-based methods by eliminating self-excited oscillations.
tldr: This paper proposes a differentiable learning framework combining a GRU-based dynamics model and neural control policy for tendon-driven continuum robots, demonstrating accurate tracking and robustness on a physical robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于腱驱动连续体机器人的可微分学习框架，结合了基于GRU的动力学模型和神经控制策略，并在物理机器人上展示了精确的跟踪和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 肌腱驱动连续体机器人由于存在复杂的非线性特性（如摩擦迟滞和传动柔顺性），在建模与控制方面提出了重大挑战。本文提出一种可微分学习框架，将高保真动力学建模与鲁棒神经控制相融合。我们开发了基于门控循环单元的动力学模型，采用双向多通道连接结构与残差预测机制，以有效抑制长期自回归预测中的累积误差。通过将该模型作为梯度传递桥梁，我们利用反向传播优化端到端神经控制策略，使其能够隐式内化对复杂非线性特性的补偿机制。在三段式物理肌腱驱动连续体机器人上的实验验证表明：该框架实现了精确轨迹跟踪，并在面对未知负载时展现出卓越的鲁棒性，通过消除自激振荡现象，其性能超越基于雅可比矩阵的传统控制方法。

title: Egocentric Tactile and Proximity Sensors as Observation Priors for Humanoid Collision Avoidance
summary: Collision-free motion is often aided by tactile and proximity sensors distributed on the body of the robot due to their resistance to occlusion as opposed to external cameras. However, how to shape the sensor's properties, such as sensing coverage; type; and range, to enable avoidant behavior remains unclear. In this work, we present a reinforcement learning framework for whole-body collision avoidance on a humanoid H1-2 robot and use it to characterize how sensor properties shape learned avoidance behavior. Using dodgeball as a benchmark task, we ablate the properties of sensors distributed across the upper body of the robot and find that raw proximity measurements can substitute for explicit object localization provided the sensing range is sufficient and that sparse non-directional proximity signals outpace dense directional alternatives in sample efficiency.
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning framework for whole-body collision avoidance on a humanoid robot, using a dodgeball task to study how properties like coverage and range of tactile and proximity sensors affect the learned avoidance behavior.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于人形机器人全身碰撞避障的强化学习框架，通过躲避球任务来研究触觉和接近传感器的覆盖范围、类型和范围等属性如何影响学习到的避障行为。
summary_zh: 机器人全身碰撞避免常借助分布于其体表的触觉与接近传感器实现，这类传感器相较于外部相机更不易受遮挡影响。然而，如何配置传感器的覆盖范围、类型与探测距离等属性以形成有效的避障行为，目前仍不明确。本研究提出了一种用于人形机器人H1-2全身避障的强化学习框架，并借此探究传感器属性如何影响学习所得的避障行为。以躲避球作为基准任务，通过对机器人上半身传感器特性进行消融实验，我们发现：当探测距离足够时，原始接近测量值可替代显式目标定位；且稀疏的非定向接近信号在样本效率上优于密集的定向替代方案。

title: ANCHOR: A Physically Grounded Closed-Loop Framework for Robust Home-Service Mobile Manipulation
summary: Recent advances in open-vocabulary mobile manipulation have brought robots into real domestic environments. In such settings, reliable long-horizon execution under open-set object references and frequent disturbances becomes essential. However, many failures persist. These are not caused by semantic misunderstanding but by inconsistencies between symbolic plans and the evolving physical world, manifested as three recurring limitations: (i) existing systems often rely on pre-scanned semantic maps that become inconsistent after scene changes and disturbances; (ii) they select navigation endpoints without considering downstream manipulation feasibility, causing the "arrived but inoperable" problem; and (iii) they handle anomalies through undifferentiated global replanning, which often fails to contain local errors. To address this execution inconsistency, we present ANCHOR, a physically grounded closed-loop framework that aligns symbolic reasoning with verifiable physical state during execution. ANCHOR integrates three mechanisms: (i) physically anchored task planning, which binds symbolic predicates to observable geometric anchors and re-validates them after each action; (ii) operability-aware base alignment, which ensures that navigation endpoints satisfy kinematic reachability and local collision feasibility; and (iii) minimum-responsible-layer hierarchical recovery, which localizes failures across perception, base-arm coordination, and execution layers to prevent cascading retries. Across 60 real-robot trials in previously unseen environments, ANCHOR improves task success from 53.3% to 71.7% and achieves a 71.4% recovery rate under perturbations, demonstrating that explicit physical grounding and structured failure containment are critical for robust mobile manipulation. Our project page is available at https://anchor9178.github.io/ANCHOR/ .
tldr: ANCHOR is a framework for robust mobile manipulation that addresses execution inconsistency by physically grounding symbolic plans, verifying manipulation feasibility at navigation endpoints, and employing structured hierarchical recovery, improving task success in unseen environments.
tldr_zh: ANCHOR是一个用于稳健移动操作的框架，通过物理接地符号规划、验证导航终端的操作可行性，以及采用结构化分层恢复，解决执行不一致性问题，在未知环境中提高了任务成功率。
summary_zh: 开放词汇移动操作技术的最新进展使得机器人得以进入真实家庭环境。在此类场景中，在开放集物体参照和频繁干扰下实现可靠的长时程执行变得至关重要，但目前仍存在诸多执行失败问题。这些失败并非源于语义理解偏差，而是由符号化规划与动态变化物理世界之间的不一致所导致，具体表现为三个常见局限：（1）现有系统通常依赖预先扫描的语义地图，这些地图在场景变化与干扰后易失效；（2）系统选择导航终点时未考虑后续操作可行性，导致“抵达却无法操作”的问题；（3）异常处理采用无差异的全局重规划策略，往往无法有效隔离局部错误。为解决此类执行不一致问题，我们提出ANCHOR——一个基于物理验证的闭环框架，在执行过程中实现符号推理与可验证物理状态的动态对齐。ANCHOR整合了三种机制：（1）物理锚定任务规划：将符号谓词绑定至可观测几何锚点，并在每次动作后重新验证；（2）操作感知的基座对准：确保导航终点满足运动学可达性与局部避碰可行性；（3）最小责任层分级恢复：通过感知层、基座-机械臂协调层与执行层的故障定位机制防止级联重试。在60次新环境真实机器人实验中，ANCHOR将任务成功率从53.3%提升至71.7%，并在扰动下实现71.4%的恢复率，证明显式的物理锚定与结构化故障隔离对实现鲁棒的移动操作至关重要。项目页面详见https://anchor9178.github.io/ANCHOR/。

title: DiscreteRTC: Discrete Diffusion Policies are Natural Asynchronous Executors
summary: Unlike chatbots, physical AI must act while the world keeps evolving. Therefore, the inter-chunk pause of synchronous executors are fatal for dynamic tasks regardless of how fast the inference is. Asynchronous execution -- thinking while acting -- is therefore a structural requirement, and real-time chunking (RTC) makes it viable by recasting chunk transitions as inpainting: freezing committed actions and consistently generating the remainder. However, RTC with flow-matching policy is structurally suboptimal: its inpainting comes from inference-time corrections rather than the base policy, yielding little pre-training benefit, specific fine-tuning, heuristic guidance, and extra computation that inflates the latency. In this work, we observe that discrete diffusion policies, which generate actions by iteratively unmasking, are natural asynchronous executors that resolve all limitations at once: they are fine-tuning free since inpainting is their native operation, while early stopping further provides adaptive guidance and reduces inference cost. We propose DiscreteRTC, which replaces external corrections with native unmasking, and show on dynamic simulated benchmarks and real-world dynamic manipulation tasks that it achieves higher success rates than continuous RTC and other baselines. In summary, DiscreteRTC is simpler to implement with 0 lines of code for async inpainting, faster at inference with only 0.7x computation compared with generating actions from scratch, and better at execution with 50% higher success rate in real-world dynamic pick task compared with flow-matching-based RTC. More visualizations are on https://outsider86.github.io/DiscreteRTCSite/.
tldr: Proposes DiscreteRTC, an asynchronous execution method for robot control policies using discrete diffusion to enable real-time planning while acting, addressing limitations of previous flow-matching approaches.
tldr_zh: 提出了DiscreteRTC，一种使用离散扩散实现机器人控制策略异步执行的方法，可在行动时进行实时规划，解决了此前流匹配方法的局限。
summary_zh: 与聊天机器人不同，物理人工智能必须在世界持续演化的过程中采取行动。因此，无论推理速度有多快，同步执行器在任务块间的暂停对于动态任务而言都是致命的。异步执行——边行动边思考——因而成为一项结构性要求，而实时分块技术通过将块间转换重构为补全过程使其可行：冻结已提交的动作并持续生成剩余部分。然而，基于流匹配策略的实时分块在结构上存在固有缺陷：其补全操作依赖于推理阶段的修正而非基础策略，导致预训练收益微乎其微，需特定微调、启发式引导及额外计算，从而增加了延迟。本研究发现，通过迭代解掩生成动作的离散扩散策略是天然的异步执行器，可一次性解决所有局限：由于补全是其固有操作，该策略无需微调；同时早期停止机制能进一步提供自适应引导并降低推理成本。我们提出DiscreteRTC方法，以原生解掩替代外部修正，并在动态模拟基准测试和真实世界动态操控任务中证明，其成功率优于连续实时分块及其他基线方法。总而言之，DiscreteRTC实现更简洁（异步补全无需额外代码），推理更快速（计算量仅为从头生成动作的0.7倍），执行更高效（在真实世界动态抓取任务中成功率比基于流匹配的实时分块提高50%）。更多可视化内容请访问：https://outsider86.github.io/DiscreteRTCSite/。

title: Logic of Fuzzy Paths
summary: We introduce a new family of temporal logics intended for specifications in motion planning (MP). It builds upon the signal temporal logic (STL), which is a linear-time logic over real-valued signals that possess quantitative semantics and thus became popular in the areas of cyber-physical systems, robotics, and specifically robot MP. However, in contrast to STL, the proposed logic works with paths as first-class citizens, separating the concerns of geometry and of logic. This in turn leads to simpler and more understandable formulae, and a more refined notion of satisfaction being able to reflect also preferences over behaviours. Technically, the logic is built on fuzzy, time-varying signal constraints. As a consequence of this expressivity, it is (i) more usable for human-given specifications in MP and (ii) more amenable to learning specifications from demonstrations than other logics. The former is important for the traditional style of verification in robot MP; the latter is becoming recognized as crucial for mining data-given tasks and controller synthesis in human-aware MP. We expose the advantages of our proposed logic on examples and show the versatility and flexibility of the framework on a number of scenarios. Finally, we give a learning algorithm with a prototype implementation and discuss the possibilities of model checking and monitoring.
tldr: A new temporal logic designed for robot motion planning that builds on Signal Temporal Logic, separates geometric and logical concerns, and aims to be more intuitive for human specification and learning from demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 提出一种用于机器人运动规划的新型时序逻辑，基于信号时序逻辑，分离了几何与逻辑问题，旨在使人机交互中的任务规范和从演示中学习更具直观性和有效性。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一系列用于运动规划规范的新型时序逻辑。这一逻辑体系建立在信号时序逻辑的基础之上，后者是一种针对实数域信号的线性时序逻辑，因其具备量化语义特性，已在信息物理系统、机器人学特别是机器人运动规划领域获得广泛应用。与信号时序逻辑不同，本文提出的逻辑将路径作为第一类对象进行处理，实现了几何特性与逻辑关系的分离。这种设计使得公式表达更为简洁易懂，同时能够通过更精细的满足度定义来反映对行为模式的偏好选择。从技术层面看，该逻辑建立在模糊时变信号约束的数学基础之上。这种表达能力的提升带来两方面优势：既更适用于运动规划中的人工制定规范，也比其他逻辑更易于通过演示数据进行规范学习。前者对机器人运动规划中的传统验证模式至关重要；后者则被公认为在人机协同运动规划中实现数据驱动任务挖掘与控制器综合的关键技术。我们通过具体案例展示了所提出逻辑的优越性，并在多种场景下验证了该框架的多功能性与灵活性。最后，我们给出了具有原型实现的学习算法，并探讨了模型检测与运行时监控的潜在应用方向。

title: VISION-SLS: Safe Perception-Based Control from Learned Visual Representations via System Level Synthesis
summary: We propose VISION-SLS, a method for nonlinear output-feedback control from high-resolution RGB images which provides robust constraint satisfaction guarantees under calibrated uncertainty bounds despite partial observability, sensor noise, and nonlinear dynamics. To enable scalability while retaining guarantees, we propose: (i) a learned low-dimensional observation map from pretrained visual features with state-dependent error bounds, and (ii) a causal affine time-varying output-feedback policy optimized via System Level Synthesis (SLS). We develop a scalable, novel solver for the resulting nonconvex program that leverages sequential convex programming coupled with efficient Riccati recursions. On two simulated visuomotor tasks (a 4D car and a 10D quadrotor) with >= 512 x 512 pixels and a 59D humanoid task with partial observability, our method enables safe, information-gathering behavior that reduces uncertainty while guaranteeing constraint satisfaction with empirically-calibrated error bounds. We also validate our method on hardware, safely controlling a ground vehicle from onboard images, outperforming baselines in safety rate and solve times. Together, these results show that learned visual abstractions coupled with an efficient solver make SLS-based safe visuomotor output-feedback practical at scale. The code implementation of our method is available at https://github.com/trustworthyrobotics/VISION-SLS.
tldr: This paper presents VISION-SLS, a method for safe visuomotor control from RGB images that uses learned visual features and System Level Synthesis to guarantee constraint satisfaction, validated in simulation and on a physical ground vehicle.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出VISION-SLS，一种从RGB图像进行安全视觉运动控制的方法，结合了学习到的视觉特征和系统级综合来保证约束满足，并在仿真和实物地面车辆上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 本文提出VISION-SLS方法，这是一种基于高分辨率RGB图像的非线性输出反馈控制方法，能够在存在部分可观测性、传感器噪声和非线性动力学的情况下，通过校准不确定性边界提供稳健的约束满足保证。为实现可扩展性同时保持理论保证，我们提出：(1) 一种基于预训练视觉特征的轻量级低维观测映射方法，其具备状态依赖型误差边界；(2) 通过系统级综合（SLS）优化的因果仿射时变输出反馈策略。我们为所得非凸规划问题开发了一种可扩展的新型求解器，该求解器结合序列凸规划与高效Riccati递归算法。在两项模拟视觉运动任务（4D汽车模型与10D四旋翼飞行器，图像分辨率≥512×512像素）及存在部分可观测性的59D人形机器人任务中，本方法在经验校准误差边界下实现了既能保障约束满足、又能通过信息采集行为降低不确定性的安全控制。我们还在硬件平台上验证了该方法，通过车载图像安全控制地面车辆，在安全率与求解时间上均优于基线方法。综合结果表明，结合高效求解器的学习型视觉抽象化方案，使基于SLS的安全视觉运动输出反馈控制具备大规模实际应用潜力。本方法的代码实现发布于https://github.com/trustworthyrobotics/VISION-SLS。

title: Privileged Foresight Distillation: Zero-Cost Future Correction for World Action Models
summary: World action models jointly predict future video and action during training, raising an open question about what role the future-prediction branch actually plays. A recent finding shows that this branch can be removed at inference with little to no loss on common manipulation benchmarks, suggesting that future information may act merely as a regularizer on the shared visual backbone. We propose instead that joint training induces an action-conditioned correction that privileged future observations impose on action denoising, and that current-only policies capture this correction only partially. Making the account precise, we formulate privileged foresight as a residual in the action-denoising direction -- the difference between what a model predicts given the true future and what it predicts given only the current frame -- and introduce \emph{Privileged Foresight Distillation (PFD)}, which transfers this residual from a training-time teacher into a small adapter on a current-only student. The teacher and student share the same backbone and differ only in the attention mask over video tokens; future video is never generated at inference. Controlled experiments verify that this gain reflects a genuine future-conditioned correction rather than a side effect of capacity or regularization. Empirically, PFD achieves consistent improvements on LIBERO and RoboTwin manipulation benchmarks while preserving the current-only inference interface at negligible added latency. This view reframes the role of future information in world action models: not as a target to predict, nor as a regularizer to absorb, but as a compressible correction to be distilled.
tldr: This paper introduces Privileged Foresight Distillation (PFD), a method to distill future-conditioned corrections from a world action model into a small adapter for a current-only student policy, improving performance on robot manipulation benchmarks without generating future frames at inference.
tldr_zh: 本文提出特权前瞻蒸馏（PFD），一种将世界动作模型中未来条件化校正提炼到仅依赖当前帧的学生策略小型适配器中的方法，在机器人操作基准上提升性能，且推理时不生成未来帧。
summary_zh: 摘要：世界动作模型在训练过程中联合预测未来视频与动作，这引发了一个开放性问题：未来预测分支究竟扮演何种角色？近期研究发现，在推理阶段移除该分支时，通用操作基准测试的性能损失极小甚至为零，这表明未来信息可能仅充当共享视觉骨干网络的正则化器。本文提出不同观点：联合训练实则诱导出一种基于未来特权观测信息对动作去噪施加的动作条件修正机制，而仅依赖当前帧的策略仅能部分捕捉这种修正。为精确阐释该机制，我们将特权前瞻性形式化为动作去噪方向的残差——即模型在给定真实未来信息时的预测与仅给定当前帧时的预测之间的差异，并引入“特权前瞻蒸馏”（Privileged Foresight Distillation, PFD）方法。该方法将此残差从训练阶段的教师模型迁移至仅使用当前帧的学生模型的小型适配器中。教师模型与学生模型共享相同骨干网络，仅通过视频令牌的注意力掩码进行区分，且推理过程中无需生成未来视频。受控实验证实，该方法带来的性能提升源于真实未来条件修正，而非容量或正则化的副作用。实证表明，PFD在LIBERO和RoboTwin操作基准测试中实现了持续改进，同时以可忽略的延迟代价保留了仅需当前帧的推理接口。这一视角重塑了未来信息在世界动作模型中的角色定位：它既非待预测的目标，亦非待吸收的正则化项，而是可被蒸馏压缩的修正信息。

title: SAMe: A Semantic Anatomy Mapping Engine for Robotic Ultrasound
summary: Robotic ultrasound has advanced local image-driven control, contact regulation, and view optimization, yet current systems lack the anatomical understanding needed to determine what to scan, where to begin, and how to adapt to individual patient anatomy. These gaps make systems still reliant on expert intervention to initiate scanning. Here we present SAMe, a semantic anatomy mapping engine that provides robotic ultrasound with an explicit anatomical prior layer. SAMe addresses scan initiation as a target-to-anatomy-to-action process: it grounds under-specified clinical complaints into structured target organs, instantiates a patient-specific anatomical representation for the grounded targets from a single external body image, and translates this representation into control-facing 6-DoF probe initialization states without any additional registration using preoperative CT or MRI. The anatomical representation maintained by SAMe is explicit, lightweight (single-organ inference in 0.08s), and compatible with downstream control by design. Across semantic grounding, anatomical instantiation, and real-robot evaluation, SAMe shows strong performance across the full initialization pipeline. In real-robot experiments, SAMe achieved overall organ-hit rates of 97.3% for liver initialization and 81.7% for kidney initialization across the evaluated target sets. Even when restricted to the centroid target, SAMe outperformed the surface-heuristic baseline for both liver and kidney initialization. These results establish an explicit anatomical prior layer that addresses scan initialization and is designed to support broader downstream autonomous scanning pipelines, providing the anatomical foundation for complaint-driven, anatomically informed robotic ultrasonography.
tldr: SAMe is a semantic anatomy mapping engine for robotic ultrasound that uses a single external body image to instantiate a patient-specific anatomical representation and generate 6-DoF probe initialization states, enabling autonomous scan initiation without pre-operative scans.
tldr_zh: SAMe是一种用于机器人超声的语义解剖映射引擎，它利用单张外部身体图像实例化患者特定解剖表征，并生成6自由度探头初始化状态，实现在无需术前CT/MRI情况下的自主扫描启动。
summary_zh: 机器人超声技术已在局部图像驱动控制、接触调节和视野优化方面取得进展，但现有系统仍缺乏确定扫描目标、起始位置及适应个体解剖结构的解剖学认知能力。这些不足导致系统仍需依赖专家介入以启动扫描。本文提出语义解剖映射引擎SAMe，为机器人超声提供显式的解剖学先验层。SAMe将扫描启动过程解构为“目标-解剖-执行”的递进框架：将模糊的临床主诉关联至结构化靶器官，通过单幅体表图像为目标器官建立患者特异性解剖表征，并无需借助术前CT或MRI配准即可将该表征转化为面向控制的六自由度探头初始位姿。SAMe构建的解剖表征具有显式化、轻量化（单器官推理耗时0.08秒）及与下游控制模块天然兼容的特性。在语义关联、解剖建模与实体机器人评估全流程中，SAMe展现出完整的初始化管道性能。实体机器人实验表明，SAMe在评估靶器官集中实现了肝脏初始化97.3%与肾脏初始化81.7%的整体器官命中率。即便限定至质心目标，SAMe在肝脏与肾脏初始化任务中仍全面超越表面启发式基线方法。本研究建立的显式解剖先验层不仅解决了扫描初始化问题，其设计更可支持更广泛的下游自主扫描流程，为主诉驱动、解剖感知的机器人超声扫描奠定了理论基础。

title: COMPASS: COmpact Multi-channel Prior-map And Scene Signature for Floor-Plan-Based Visual Localization
summary: Architectural floor plans are widely available priors which contain not only geometry but also the semantic information of the environment, yet existing localization methods largely ignore this semantic information. To address this, we present COMPASS, an algorithm that exploits both geometric and semantic priors from floor plans to estimate the pose of a robot equipped with dual fisheye cameras. Inspired by scan context descriptor from LiDAR-based place recognition, we design a multi-channel radial descriptor that encodes the geometric layout surrounding a position. From the floor plan, rays are cast in 360 azimuth bins and the results are encoded into five channels: normalized range, structural hit type (wall, window, or opening), range gradient, inverse range, and local range variance. From the image side, the same descriptor structure is populated by detecting structural elements in the fisheye imagery. As a first step toward full cross-modal matching, we present a window detection algorithm for fisheye images that uses a line segment detector to identify window frames via vertical edge clustering and brightness verification. Detected windows are projected to azimuthal bearings through the fisheye camera model, producing the hit-type channel of the visual descriptor. As a proof of concept, we generate both descriptors at a single known pose from the Hilti-Trimble SLAM Challenge 2026 dataset and demonstrate that the wall-window pattern extracted from the first frame of each camera closely matches the floor plan descriptor, validating the feasibility of cross-modal structural matching.
tldr: COMPASS proposes a visual localization method for robots using dual fisheye cameras by matching a multi-channel radial descriptor (encoding geometry and semantic structural elements) constructed from images against a similar descriptor derived from architectural floor plans.
tldr_zh: COMPASS 提出了一种机器人视觉定位方法，利用双鱼眼摄像头，通过将图像构建的多通道径向描述符（编码几何和语义结构元素）与从建筑平面图导出的类似描述符进行匹配。
summary_zh: 建筑平面图是广泛可用的先验信息，它既包含环境的几何结构也蕴含语义信息，然而现有定位方法大多忽略了这些语义信息。为此，我们提出COMPASS算法，该算法利用平面图中的几何和语义先验信息，通过搭载双鱼眼相机的机器人实现位姿估计。受基于激光雷达的位置识别中扫描上下文描述符的启发，我们设计了一种多通道径向描述符，用于编码位置周边的几何布局。从平面图出发，我们在360个方位角区间内投射射线，将结果编码为五个通道：归一化距离、结构命中类型（墙体、窗户或开口）、距离梯度、逆距离和局部距离方差。在图像侧，通过检测鱼眼图像中的结构元素填充相同的描述符结构。作为实现跨模态匹配的第一步，我们提出一种鱼眼图像窗户检测算法：使用线段检测器通过垂直边缘聚类与亮度验证识别窗框，检测到的窗户通过鱼眼相机模型投影至方位角方向，从而生成视觉描述符的命中类型通道。作为概念验证，我们使用Hilti-Trimble 2026年SLAM挑战赛数据集中的单已知位姿生成两种描述符，并证明从各相机首帧图像提取的墙窗模式与平面图描述符高度吻合，验证了跨模态结构匹配的可行性。

title: An analysis of sensor selection for fruit picking with suction-based grippers
summary: Robotic fruit harvesting often fails to reliably detect whether a fruit has been successfully picked, limiting efficiency and increasing crop damage. This problem is difficult due to compliant fruit and grippers, variable stem attachment, and occlusions in orchard environments. Prior work has explored vision-based perception and multi-sensor learning approaches for pick state estimation. However, minimal sensor sets and phase-dependent sensing strategies for accurate pick and slip detection remain largely unexplored. In this work, we design and evaluate a multimodal sensing suite integrated into a compliant suction-based apple gripper. Our approach is unique because it identifies which sensors are most informative at different phases of the pick, enabling predictive detection of failures before they occur. The contributions of this paper are a phase-dependent evaluation of multimodal sensors and the identification of minimal sensor sets for reliable pick state classification. Experiments in a real apple orchard show that Random Forest and Multilayer Perceptron classifiers detect successful picks and impending failures with over 90% accuracy, and Random Forest predicts pick/slip events within 0.09 s of human-annotated ground truth.
tldr: This paper studies optimal sensor selection for pick detection in robotic apple harvesting using a suction gripper, identifying phase-dependent sensor importance and achieving over 90% accuracy in pick/slip detection.
tldr_zh: 本文研究用于机器人苹果采摘的吸盘夹爪的最佳传感器选择，识别了采摘阶段依赖的传感器重要性，并在采摘/滑落检测中实现了超过90%的准确率。
summary_zh: 机器人果实采摘往往难以可靠地检测果实是否被成功采摘，这限制了采摘效率并增加了作物损伤。该问题因果实与夹具的柔顺性、果梗连接方式的多样性以及果园环境中的遮挡现象而变得尤为棘手。先前研究已探索了基于视觉的感知方法和多传感器学习策略用于采摘状态估计。然而，针对精确采摘与滑脱检测的最小化传感器组合及分阶段感知策略仍鲜有研究。本文设计并评估了一种集成于柔性真空吸附式苹果采摘夹具的多模态传感系统。本方法的独特之处在于，它能识别采摘不同阶段中最具信息价值的传感器类型，从而实现对采摘失败事件的预测性检测。本文的贡献在于：提出了多模态传感器的分阶段评估方法，并确定了用于可靠采摘状态分类的最小化传感器组合。在真实苹果园进行的实验表明，随机森林和多层感知器分类器对成功采摘与即将发生的失败事件检测准确率超过90%，且随机森林模型预测的采摘/滑脱事件时间与人工标注真值相差仅0.09秒。

title: Where Did It Go Wrong? Capability-Oriented Failure Attribution for Vision-and-Language Navigation Agents
summary: Embodied agents in safety-critical applications such as Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) rely on multiple interdependent capabilities (e.g., perception, memory, planning, decision), making failures difficult to localize and attribute. Existing testing methods are largely system-level and provide limited insight into which capability deficiencies cause task failures. We propose a capability-oriented testing approach that enables failure detection and attribution by combining (1) adaptive test case generation via seed selection and mutation, (2) capability oracles for identifying capability-specific errors, and (3) a feedback mechanism that attributes failures to capabilities and guides further test generation. Experiments show that our method discovers more failure cases and more accurately pinpoints capability-level deficiencies than state-of-the-art baselines, providing more interpretable and actionable guidance for improving embodied agents.
tldr: The paper proposes a capability-oriented testing framework to detect and attribute failures in Vision-Language Navigation agents by generating adaptive test cases and using capability-specific oracles, improving interpretability for agent development.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种面向能力的测试框架，通过生成自适应测试用例和使用特定能力预言机，来检测和归因视觉语言导航智能体中的失败，为智能体开发提供更可解释的指导。
summary_zh: 在视觉语言导航等安全关键应用中，具身智能体依赖多种相互依赖的能力（如感知、记忆、规划、决策），导致故障难以定位与归因。现有测试方法多为系统级测试，难以揭示任务失败具体由何种能力缺陷引起。本文提出一种面向能力的测试方法，通过以下方式实现故障检测与归因：（1）通过种子选择与变异进行自适应测试用例生成；（2）采用能力预言机制识别特定能力错误；（3）设计反馈机制将故障归因于具体能力并指导后续测试生成。实验表明，与现有先进基线方法相比，本方法能发现更多故障案例，更精准定位能力层级缺陷，为改进具身智能体提供更具可解释性与可操作性的指导。

title: Dyna-Style Safety Augmented Reinforcement Learning: Staying Safe in the Face of Uncertainty
summary: Safety remains an open problem in reinforcement learning (RL), especially during training. While safety filters are promising to address safe exploration, they are generally poorly suited for high-dimensional systems with unknown dynamics. We propose Dyna-style Safety Augmented Reinforcement Learning (Dyna-SAuR), a novel algorithm that learns both a scalable safety filter and a control policy using a learned uncertainty-aware dynamics model, while requiring minimal domain knowledge. The filter avoids failures and high uncertainty regions. Thus, better models expand the set of safe and certain states, reducing filter conservatism. We present the effectiveness of Dyna-SAuR on goal-reaching CartPole as well as MuJoCo Walker, reducing failures compared to state-of-the-art methods by 2 orders of magnitude.
tldr: Proposes a novel algorithm for safe reinforcement learning, Dyna-SAuR, which learns a safety filter and control policy using a dynamics model to avoid failures and high uncertainty regions, demonstrated on CartPole and MuJoCo Walker tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种新颖的安全强化学习算法Dyna-SAuR，通过使用动态模型学习安全过滤器和控制策略，以避免失败和高不确定性区域，并在CartPole和MuJoCo Walker任务上进行了演示。
summary_zh: 强化学习中的安全性问题仍然悬而未决，尤其是在训练阶段。虽然安全过滤器有望解决安全探索的难题，但它们通常难以适用于动态特性未知的高维系统。我们提出了基于动态模型的安全增强强化学习算法（Dyna-SAuR），这是一种新颖的算法，能够利用学习得到的具有不确定性感知能力的动态模型，同时学习可扩展的安全过滤器与控制策略，且对领域知识的要求极低。该过滤器能有效避开故障区域和高不确定性区域。因此，更好的模型可以扩展安全与确定性状态集合，从而降低过滤器的保守性。我们在目标导向的CartPole任务以及MuJoCo Walker环境中验证了Dyna-SAuR的有效性，与现有先进方法相比，故障发生率降低了两个数量级。

title: Biased Dreams: Limitations to Epistemic Uncertainty Quantification in Latent Space Models
summary: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning distinguishes between physical dynamics models operating on proprioceptive inputs and latent dynamics models operating on high-dimensional image observations. A prominent latent approach is the Recurrent State Space Model used in the Dreamer family. While epistemic uncertainty quantification to inform exploration and mitigate model exploitation is well established for physical dynamics models, its transfer to latent dynamics models has received limited scrutiny. We empirically demonstrate that latent transitions are biased toward well-represented regions of latent space, exhibiting an attractor behavior that can deviate from true environment dynamics. As a result, discrepancies in environment dynamics may not manifest in latent space, undermining the reliability of epistemic uncertainty estimates. Because these attractors often lie in high-reward regions, latent rollouts systematically overestimate predicted rewards. Our findings highlight key limitations of epistemic uncertainty estimation in latent dynamics models and motivate more critical evaluation of this method.
tldr: This paper demonstrates a fundamental limitation of epistemic uncertainty estimation in latent dynamics models like Dreamer, showing latent transitions are biased towards well-represented regions, which can lead to unreliable uncertainty estimates and overly optimistic reward predictions.
tldr_zh: 本文揭示了Dreamer等潜在动力学模型中认知不确定性估计的一个根本缺陷，即潜在状态的转移偏向于已充分表征的区域，这可能导致不可靠的不确定性估计和过于乐观的奖励预测。
summary_zh: 基于模型的强化学习区分了两种动态模型：一种是在本体感知输入上操作的物理动态模型，另一种是在高维图像观测上操作的潜在动态模型。一种主流的潜在方法是Dreamer系列中使用的循环状态空间模型。尽管在物理动态模型中，用于指导探索和减轻模型利用的认知不确定性量化已得到充分确立，但将其迁移到潜在动态模型的研究却鲜有深入探讨。我们通过实验证明，潜在状态的转换偏向于潜在空间中已充分表征的区域，表现出一种吸引子行为，可能与真实环境动态产生偏离。因此，环境动态的差异在潜在空间中可能不会显现，从而削弱了认知不确定性估计的可靠性。由于这些吸引子往往位于高奖励区域，潜在轨迹会系统性高估预测奖励。我们的研究结果揭示了潜在动态模型中认知不确定性估计的关键局限性，并呼吁对该方法进行更严格的评估。

title: Sensitivity-Based Tube NMPC for Cooperative Aerial Structures Under Parametric Uncertainty
summary: This paper presents a sensitivity-based tube Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) framework for cooperative aerial chains under bounded parametric uncertainty. We consider a planar two-vehicle chain connected by rigid links, modeled with input-rate actuation to enforce slew-rate and magnitude limits on thrust and torque. Robustness to uncertainty in link mass, length, and inertia is achieved by propagating first-order parametric state sensitivities along the horizon and using them to compute online constraint-tightening margins. We robustify an inter-link separation constraint, implemented via a smooth cosine embedding, and thrust-magnitude bounds. The method is implemented in MATLAB and evaluated with boundary-hugging maneuvers and Monte-Carlo uncertainty sampling. Results show improved constraint margins under uncertainty with tracking performance comparable to nominal NMPC.
tldr: This paper presents a robust NMPC framework for cooperative aerial vehicle chains with parametric uncertainty, using sensitivity-based constraint tightening.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于灵敏度的鲁棒非线性模型预测控制框架，用于处理存在参数不确定性的协作空中链条系统。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于灵敏度的鲁棒非线性模型预测控制框架，应用于存在有界参数不确定性下的协同空中链式系统。我们研究了由刚性连杆连接的平面双飞行器链式结构，该模型采用输入速率驱动机制，以对推力和扭矩施加变化率与幅值约束。通过沿预测时域传播一阶参数状态灵敏度，并利用其在线计算约束收紧裕度，实现了对连杆质量、长度及转动惯量不确定性的鲁棒性。我们通过平滑余弦嵌入方法强化了链间间距约束，同时对推力幅值边界进行了鲁棒化处理。该框架在MATLAB中实现，并通过边界贴合机动与蒙特卡洛不确定性采样进行评估。结果表明，在不确定性条件下该方法能有效提升约束裕度，同时保持与标称非线性模型预测控制相当的轨迹跟踪性能。

title: Optimal UGV-UAV Cooperative Partitioning and Inspection of Shortest Paths
summary: We study cooperative shortest path planning for an unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) assisted by an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in environments with unknown road blockages that are only discovered when a robot reaches the damaged point. This formulation generalizes the original Canadian Traveller Problem (CTP), which assumes a single ground vehicle and that the traversability status of all incident edges is revealed upon arrival at a vertex. We first analyze the case where the start and the goal are connected by $k$ disjoint paths, and prove that the worst-case competitive ratio $ρ$ for a single UGV is $2k-1$. With UAV assistance, and under the simplifying assumption of negligible initial transit and deadheading UAV costs, the ratio improves to $ρ= 2\frac{v_G}{v_A + v_G}k - 1$, where $v_G$ and $v_A$ denote the UGV and UAV speed, respectively. To address general graphs and non-negligible UAV initial transit and deadheading costs, we present an optimal path partitioning strategy that assigns path prefix inspection to the UGV and path suffix inspection to the UAV, and prove the optimality of the UAV inspection strategy on general graphs. We evaluate our algorithm by performing experiments on road networks from the world's 50 most populous cities, with randomized blockages, and show that the proposed method reduces UGV travel times by up to 30%.
tldr: This paper studies cooperative path planning for a UGV and a UAV in environments with unknown road blockages, extending the Canadian Traveller Problem to multi-robot systems, and presents optimal path partitioning strategies that reduce UGV travel times.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在存在未知道路阻塞的环境中，UGV与UAV协作的路径规划问题，扩展了加拿大旅行者问题，并提出了最优路径分割策略，显著降低了UGV的旅行时间。
summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种无人机辅助无人地面车辆在未知道路堵塞环境中进行协同最短路径规划的问题。该环境中道路堵塞信息仅当机器人抵达受损点时才被揭示。该模型推广了经典的加拿大旅行者问题——原问题假设仅存在单一地面车辆，且车辆到达顶点时即能获知所有相邻边的可通行状态。我们首先分析了起点与终点之间存在k条独立路径的情形，证明了单一无人地面车辆的最坏情况竞争比ρ为2k-1。在无人机辅助下，并忽略无人机初始部署与空载成本的简化假设下，竞争比改善为ρ=2(v_G/(v_A+v_G))k-1，其中v_G和v_A分别表示地面车辆与无人机的速度。针对一般拓扑图结构及不可忽略的无人机初始部署与空载成本，我们提出一种最优路径分割策略：将路径前段检测任务分配给地面车辆，后段检测任务分配给无人机，并证明了该无人机检测策略在一般图上的最优性。通过在50个世界人口最稠密城市的路网中进行随机堵塞模拟实验，评估结果表明所提方法能减少无人地面车辆高达30%的行驶时间。

title: TSN-Affinity: Similarity-Driven Parameter Reuse for Continual Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Continual offline reinforcement learning (CORL) aims to learn a sequence of tasks from datasets collected over time while preserving performance on previously learned tasks. This setting corresponds to domains where new tasks arise over time, but adapting the model in live environment interactions is expensive, risky, or impossible. However, CORL inherits the dual difficulty of offline reinforcement learning and adapting while preventing catastrophic forgetting. Replay-based continual learning approaches remain a strong baseline but incur memory overhead and suffer from a distribution mismatch between replayed samples and newly learned policies. At the same time, architectural continual learning methods have shown strong potential in supervised learning but remain underexplored in CORL. In this work, we propose TSN-Affinity, a novel CORL method based on TinySubNetworks and Decision Transformer. The method enables task-specific parameterization and controlled knowledge sharing through a RL-aware reuse strategy that routes tasks according to action compatibility and latent similarity. We evaluate the approach on benchmarks based on Atari games and simulations of manipulation tasks with the Franka Emika Panda robotic arm, covering both discrete and continuous control. Results show strong retention from sparse SubNetworks, with routing further improving multi-task performance. Our findings suggest that similarity-guided architectural reuse is a strong and viable alternative to replay-based strategies in a CORL setting. Our code is available at: https://github.com/anonymized-for-submission123/tsn-affinity.
tldr: This paper proposes TSN-Affinity, a method for Continual Offline RL using task-specific subnetworks and decision transformer with a RL-aware reuse strategy to share knowledge across tasks based on action compatibility and latent similarity, evaluated on Atari and robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出TSN-Affinity，一种用于持续离线强化学习的方法，利用任务特定子网络和决策变换器，通过基于动作兼容性和潜在相似性的RL感知重用策略，在Atari和机器人操作任务上进行了评估。
summary_zh: 持续离线强化学习（CORL）旨在利用随时间收集的数据集序列学习一系列任务，同时保持对已学任务的性能。该设定对应于任务随时间不断涌现的应用场景，但在实时环境交互中调整模型成本高昂、存在风险或无法实现。然而，CORL同时继承了离线强化学习和适应过程中的双重挑战，还需防范灾难性遗忘。基于回放的持续学习方法仍是重要基线，但会产生内存开销，并面临回放样本与新学习策略之间的分布失配问题。与此同时，架构型持续学习方法在监督学习中已展现出强大潜力，但在CORL领域仍待深入探索。本文提出TSN-Affinity——一种基于微型子网络与决策Transformer的新型CORL方法。该方法通过强化学习感知的重用策略实现任务特异性参数化与可控知识共享，该策略依据动作兼容性与潜在相似性对任务进行路径分配。我们在基于Atari游戏的基准测试及Franka Emika Panda机械臂操作任务仿真环境中对该方法进行评估，涵盖离散与连续控制场景。实验结果表明，稀疏子网络结构能实现强记忆保持能力，而路径分配机制可进一步提升多任务性能。我们的研究证实，在CORL场景中，相似性引导的架构重用策略是基于回放策略的有效替代方案。代码已开源：https://github.com/anonymized-for-submission123/tsn-affinity。

title: Multi-action Tangled Program Graphs for Multi-task Reinforcement Learning with Continuous Control
summary: Over the past few decades, machine learning has been widely used to learn complex tasks. Reinforcement Learning (RL), inspired by human behavior, is a great example, as it involves developing specific behaviours for specific tasks. To further challenge algorithms, Multi-Task RL (MTRL) environments have been introduced, requiring a single model to learn multiple behaviors. The Tangled Program Graph (TPG) algorithm is a Genetic Programming (GP) algorithm designed for discrete MTRL environments. Recently, the MAPLE algorithm has been proposed, as another GP algorithm that achieves high results in single task continuous RL environments. A variation of the TPG is proposed alongside MAPLE, named Multi-Action TPG (MATPG) that aggregates MAPLE agents, and creates a control flow to activate them. Initially tested on single task RL environments only, MATPG achieved similar results to MAPLE. In this work, we present a new benchmark based on the MuJoCo Half Cheetah from Gymnasium. This benchmark features five distinct obstacles that are randomly positioned in front of the agent, each of which demands a unique behavior. This benchmark serves as a use case for MATPG, to prove its ability as a GP solution for continuous MTRL environments. Our experiments demonstrate its superiority in this multi-task use case when combined with lexicase selection. Furthermore, we examine the interpretability of the evolved graph, revealing that the decision flow of the model is fully interpretable.
tldr: This paper introduces a Multi-Action Tangled Program Graph (MATPG) algorithm, a genetic programming approach for multi-task reinforcement learning in continuous control environments, tested on a custom MuJoCo Half Cheetah benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多动作纠缠程序图（MATPG）算法，这是一种用于连续控制环境中多任务强化学习的遗传编程方法，并在自定义的 MuJoCo Half Cheetah 基准测试中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 在过去的几十年中，机器学习已被广泛应用于复杂任务的学习。强化学习（RL）作为受人类行为启发的典型案例，涉及为特定任务开发对应的特定行为策略。为进一步挑战算法能力，多任务强化学习（MTRL）环境应运而生，它要求单一模型学习多种行为。纠缠程序图（TPG）算法是一种专为离散MTRL环境设计的遗传规划（GP）算法。近年来提出的MAPLE算法则是另一种在单任务连续RL环境中取得优异性能的GP算法。本研究基于MAPLE框架提出TPG的变体——多动作TPG（MATPG），该算法通过聚合MAPLE智能体并构建激活控制流来实现多任务决策。初步仅在单任务RL环境中测试时，MATPG取得了与MAPLE相当的结果。本文基于Gymnasium的MuJoCo Half Cheetah环境构建了新基准测试，该基准设置了五个随机出现在智能体前方的不同障碍物，每种障碍均需要不同的应对行为。此基准测试作为MATPG的应用场景，验证了其作为连续MTRL环境GP解决方案的有效性。实验表明，结合字典序选择策略的MATPG在此多任务场景中具有显著优势。此外，我们对演化图的解释性进行分析，发现模型决策流程具有完全可解释性。

title: Threat-Oriented Digital Twinning for Security Evaluation of Autonomous Platforms
summary: Open, unclassified research on secure autonomy is constrained by limited access to operational platforms, contested communications infrastructure, and representative adversarial test conditions. This paper presents a threat-oriented digital twinning methodology for cybersecurity evaluation of learning-enabled autonomous platforms. The approach is instantiated as an open-source, modular twin of a representative autonomy stack with separated sensing, autonomy, and supervisory-control functions; confidence-gated multi-modal perception; explicit command and telemetry trust boundaries; and runtime hold-safe behavior. The contribution is methodological: a reproducible design pattern that translates threat analysis into observable, controllable tests for spoofing, replay, malformed-input injection, degraded sensing, and adversarial ML stress. Although the implemented proxy is ground based, the architecture is intentionally framed around stack elements shared with UAV and space systems, including constrained onboard compute, intermittent or high-latency links, probabilistic perception, and mission-critical recovery behavior. The result is an implementable research scaffold for dependable and secure autonomy studies across UAV and space domains.
tldr: This paper presents a threat-oriented digital twin methodology for cybersecurity evaluation of learning-enabled autonomous platforms, focusing on a modular autonomy stack design for reproducible security testing in UAV and space systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种面向威胁的数字孪生方法，用于评估学习型自主平台的网络安全，其模块化自主栈设计为无人机和太空系统提供了可复现的安全测试框架。
summary_zh: 关于安全自主性的公开、非保密研究受制于对操作平台访问受限、通信基础设施竞争激烈以及缺乏典型对抗性测试条件等挑战。本文提出一种面向威胁的数字孪生方法，用于对具备学习能力的自主平台进行网络安全评估。该方法通过一个开源的模块化孪生系统实现，该系统复现了典型自主架构的核心特征：分离的感知、自主决策与监控功能；基于置信度门控的多模态感知；明确划分的指令与遥测信任边界；以及运行时安全保护行为。本研究的核心贡献在于方法论层面：提出一种可复现的设计模式，能够将威胁分析转化为可观测、可控制的测试方案，涵盖欺骗攻击、重放攻击、畸形输入注入、感知能力降级及对抗性机器学习压力测试等场景。虽然当前实现版本基于地面平台，但架构设计刻意围绕与无人机及空间系统共通的堆栈要素展开，包括受限的机载计算能力、间歇性或高延迟通信链路、概率化感知系统以及任务关键型恢复行为。最终构建出一个可实施的跨领域研究框架，为无人机和空间领域的可靠安全自主性研究提供支撑。

title: GEGLU-Transformer for IMU-to-EMG Estimation with Few-Shot Adaptation
summary: Reliable estimation of neuromuscular activation is a key enabler for adaptive and personalized control in wearable robotics. However, surface electromyography (EMG) remains difficult to deploy robustly outside laboratory settings due to electrode sensitivity, signal non-stationarity, and strong subject dependence. In this work, we propose an adaptive IMU-to-EMG learning framework that reconstructs continuous muscle activation envelopes from wearable inertial measurements across heterogeneous movement conditions. The approach combines a Transformer encoder with Gaussian Error Gated Linear Units (GEGLU-Transformer) to enhance cross-subject generalization and enable rapid subject-specific personalization. Under a strict leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) protocol on a multi-condition lower-limb biomechanics dataset, the proposed architecture achieves r = 0.706 +/- 0.139 and R^2 = 0.474 +/- 0.208 without subject-specific adaptation. With only 0.5% adaptation data, performance increases to r = 0.761 +/- 0.030 and R^2 = 0.559 +/- 0.047, demonstrating rapid adaptation and early performance saturation. These results support attention-based architectures combined with lightweight adaptation as a practical and scalable alternative to direct EMG sensing for real-world wearable robotic applications.
tldr: This paper proposes a GEGLU-Transformer for estimating muscle activity (EMG) from wearable IMU data, with a few-shot adaptation module for personalized control in wearable robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于GEGLU-Transformer的模型，利用可穿戴IMU数据估计肌肉活动（EMG），并包含少样本适应模块，用于可穿戴机器人中的个性化控制。

title: SlicerRoboTMS: An Open-Source 3D Slicer Extension for Robot-Assisted Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation
summary: Robot-assisted Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (Robo-TMS) is an image-guided robotic intervention that enhances the accuracy and reproducibility of conventional Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS), a widely used non-invasive brain stimulation procedure in clinical treatment and neuroscience research. Despite its potential, the development of Robo-TMS remains challenging due to the need for multidisciplinary expertise spanning medical imaging, computer vision, and robotics. This paper presents SlicerRoboTMS, an open-source 3D Slicer extension that provides a unified interaction infrastructure for Robo-TMS research. By leveraging 3D Slicer's medical image computing and visualisation capabilities, the extension supports Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI)-based neuronavigation and interfaces with robotic systems through standardised communication protocols and configurable system descriptions. An example integration is presented to demonstrate how SlicerRoboTMS can be incorporated into a representative Robo-TMS workflow. Designed to support diverse hardware configurations and rapid prototyping, SlicerRoboTMS lowers the barrier to entry and facilitates reproducible and extensible research in Robo-TMS. The extension is available at https://github.com/OpenRoboTMS/SlicerRoboTMS.
tldr: This paper presents an open-source software extension for 3D Slicer that provides a unified platform for robot-assisted transcranial magnetic stimulation (Robo-TMS), integrating medical imaging, navigation, and robot interfacing to lower the barrier to entry for this multidisciplinary field.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于3D Slicer的开源软件扩展，为机器人辅助经颅磁刺激（Robo-TMS）研究提供了一个统一的平台，整合了医学影像、导航和机器人接口，旨在降低该跨学科领域的研究门槛。

title: Improving Sensing Coverage and Compliance of 3D-Printed Artificial Skins Through Multi-Modal Sensing and Soft Materials
summary: 3D-printed artificial skins are a scalable approach to whole-body tactile and proximity coverage, but prior implementations have been limited to unimodal sensing and rigid materials. To improve the practical usability of 3D-printed artificial skins, we present a hybrid time-of-flight (ToF) and self-capacitance (SC) sensing skin that demonstrates multi-modal sensing integration, soft compliant coverings for impact absorption and pressure sensing, and a streamlined electrical interface between printed conductive traces and external electronics. We show that combining ToF and SC modalities enables contact detection, scene reconstruction, and pressure-correlated tactile responses with the compliant covering by deploying six artificial skin units with 40 sensing elements over an FR3 robot arm.
tldr: This paper presents a 3D-printed artificial skin with multi-modal sensing and soft materials, demonstrated on a robot arm for contact detection and scene reconstruction.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种具有多模态感知和软质材料的3D打印人工皮肤，在机器人手臂上演示了接触检测和场景重建。

title: Bridging the Indoor-Outdoor Gap: Cross-Technology Ranging for Seamless Robot Navigation
summary: Mobile robots that move between outdoor and indoor environments still struggle with consistent positioning. Satellite-based and terrestrial ranging each work well in their home domains, but combining them at the raw measurement level has received little attention, and the building boundary is precisely where both classes degrade. This paper reports preliminary observations from the HYMN dataset, which time-synchronizes raw measurements from GNSS, Ultra-Wideband (UWB), WiFi Fine Time Measurement (FTM), and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) against millimeter-level ground truth in an industrial setting. Per-zone measurement availability and ranging-residual behavior are characterised. The two technology classes turn out to be complementary, and the indoor-outdoor transition is where their weaknesses overlap. The dataset is publicly available.
tldr: This paper presents the HYMN dataset for evaluating cross-technology ranging methods to improve robot navigation across indoor-outdoor boundaries, combining GNSS, UWB, WiFi FTM, and BLE measurements.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了HYMN数据集，用于评估跨技术测距方法，以改善机器人在室内外边界处的导航，融合了GNSS、UWB、WiFi FTM和BLE测量数据。

title: Robust Graph Matching through Semantic Relationship Generation for SLAM
summary: Graph-based representations such as Scene Graphs enable localization in structured indoor environments by matching a locally observed graph, constructed from sensor data, to a prior map. This process is particularly challenging in environments with repetitive or symmetric layouts, where structural cues alone are often insufficient to resolve ambiguities. We propose a semantic-enhanced graph matching approach that explicitly models relations between detected objects and structural elements, such as rooms and wall planes. Objects are detected from RGB-D data and integrated into the graph, and their relations to structural elements are exploited to filter candidate correspondences prior to geometric verification, significantly reducing ambiguity and search complexity. The proposed method is integrated within the iS-Graphs framework and evaluated in synthetic and simulated environments. Results show that semantic relations significantly reduce the number of candidate matches, improve computational efficiency, and enable faster convergence, particularly in symmetric scenarios where purely geometric approaches fail.
tldr: This paper proposes a semantic-enhanced graph matching method for SLAM that uses object-to-structure relationships to resolve ambiguities in repetitive environments, improving matching efficiency and robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于SLAM的语义增强图匹配方法，利用物体与结构元素之间的关系来解决重复环境中的模糊问题，提高了匹配效率和鲁棒性。

title: Dynamic UGV-UAV Cooperative Path Planning in Uncertain Environments
summary:
This paper addresses the Dynamic UGV-UAV Cooperative Path Planning (DUCPP) problem involving one unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) assisted by one or more unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) operating on an uncertain road network with potentially impassable edges. DUCPP is particularly relevant for scenarios such as disaster response, emergency supply transport, and rescue operations, where a UGV must reach a specified destination in the presence of partially unknown road conditions. To enable the UGV to travel safely and efficiently to its destination, the UAV(s) dynamically inspect edges in the environment to identify and prune damaged or impassable edges from consideration.
  We present multiple strategies, including a bidirectional approach, to optimize UGV-UAV cooperation for finding a safe path in an uncertain road network. Furthermore, we explore the impact of using multiple UAVs on reducing the UGV's travel time, and evaluate the associated computation time. The proposed strategies are implemented and evaluated on 100 urban road networks. The results demonstrate that the bidirectional strategy achieves the best performance in most instances, and using multiple UAVs further reduces UGV travel time at the expense of increased computation time. This paper presents a robust framework for DUCPP to achieve efficient UGV-UAV cooperation for path planning and inspection, offering practical solutions for navigation in challenging and uncertain conditions.
tldr: This paper proposes strategies for dynamic cooperative path planning between a ground vehicle (UGV) and aerial vehicles (UAVs) for navigation in uncertain road networks, focusing on inspection and route optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了在地面无人车（UGV）和空中无人机（UAV）之间进行动态协同路径规划的策略，用于在不确定道路网络中通过动态检查进行导航和路线优化。

title: Safe-Support Q-Learning: Learning without Unsafe Exploration
summary: Ensuring safety during reinforcement learning (RL) training is critical in real-world applications where unsafe exploration can lead to devastating outcomes. While most safe RL methods mitigate risk through constraints or penalization, they still allow exploration of unsafe states during training. In this work, we adopt a stricter safety requirement that eliminates unsafe state visitation during training. To achieve this goal, we propose a Q-learning-based safe RL framework that leverages a behavior policy supported on a safe set. Under the assumption that the induced trajectories remain within the safe set, this policy enables sufficient exploration within the safe region without requiring near-optimality. We adopt a two-stage framework in which the Q-function and policy are trained separately. Specifically, we introduce a KL-regularized Bellman target that constrains the Q-function to remain close to the behavior policy. We then derive the policy induced from the trained Q-values and propose a parametric policy extraction method to approximate the optimal policy. Our approach provides a unified framework that can be adapted to different action spaces and types of behavior policies. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves stable learning and well-calibrated value estimates and yields safer behavior with comparable or better performance than existing baselines.
tldr: The paper proposes a Q-learning-based safe reinforcement learning framework that uses a behavior policy to prevent unsafe state visitation during training, enabling safe exploration without requiring near-optimality, and demonstrates improved safety and comparable performance in experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Q学习的强化学习框架，通过行为策略来防止训练期间的不安全状态访问，实现了安全探索，并且在实验中展示了更好的安全性和可比性能。

title: Multi-Periodogram Velocity Estimation with Irregular Reference Signals for Robot-Aided ISAC
summary: This paper addresses velocity estimation within robot-aided integrated sensing and communications (ISAC), where mobile robots act as sensing nodes but can only opportunistically reuse irregular 5G/6G reference signals (RSs). We show that the velocity profile induced by such irregular time-domain patterns can be decomposed into a periodic-peak component and an amplitude-shaping (weighting) component. Leveraging this structure, we propose a multi-periodogram velocity estimation algorithm that is standard-compliant and does not require new sensing-dedicated RSs or 3GPP modifications. Simulation results demonstrate that, compared with conventional periodogram processing, the proposed method improves low-SNR robustness by achieving a 3 dB SNR gain at the 10% missed-detection rate and reducing false alarms by 51%.
tldr: This paper proposes a novel multi-periodogram algorithm for velocity estimation in robot-aided ISAC systems, improving robustness by exploiting the structure of irregular 5G/6G reference signals.
tldr_zh: 本文针对机器人辅助的集成感知与通信提出了一种多周期图速度估计算法，通过利用不规则5G/6G参考信号的结构，提高了系统的鲁棒性。

title: Sample-efficient Neuro-symbolic Proximal Policy Optimization
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) algorithms often require a large amount of data and struggle in sparse-reward domains with long planning horizons and multiple sub-goals. In this paper, we propose a neuro-symbolic extension of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) that transfers partial logical policy specifications learned in easier instances to guide learning in more challenging settings. We introduce two integrations of symbolic guidance: (i) H-PPO-Product, which biases the action distribution at sampling time, and (ii) H-PPO-SymLoss, which augments the PPO loss with a symbolic regularization term. We evaluate our methods on three benchmarks (OfficeWorld, WaterWorld, and DoorKey), showing consistently faster learning and higher return at convergence than PPO and a Reward Machine baseline, also under imperfect symbolic knowledge.
tldr: This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic extension of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) that uses logical policy specifications to improve sample efficiency and performance in sparse-reward, long-horizon tasks, evaluated on discrete grid-world environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种神经符号近端策略优化（PPO）扩展方法，利用逻辑策略规范提升稀疏奖励、长规划任务中的样本效率和性能，并在离散网格世界环境中进行了评估。

title: Benchmarking and Improving GUI Agents in High-Dynamic Environments
summary: Recent advancements in Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have predominantly focused on training paradigms like supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). However, the challenge of high-dynamic GUI environments remains largely underexplored. Existing agents typically rely on a single screenshot after each action for decision-making, leading to a partially observable (or even unobservable) Markov decision process, where the key GUI state including important information for actions is often inadequately captured. To systematically explore this challenge, we introduce DynamicGUIBench, a comprehensive online GUI benchmark spanning ten applications and diverse interaction scenarios characterized by important interface changes between actions. Furthermore, we present DynamicUI, an agent designed for dynamic interfaces, which takes screen-recording videos of the interaction process as input and consists of three components: a dynamic perceiver, a refinement strategy, and a reflection. Specifically, the dynamic perceiver clusters frames of the GUI video, generates captions for the centroids, and iteratively selects the most informative frames as the salient dynamic context. Considering that there may be inconsistencies and noise between the selected frames and the textual context of the agent, the refinement strategy employs an action-conditioned filtering to refine thoughts to mitigate thought-action inconsistency and redundancy. Based on the refined agent trajectories, the reflection module provides effective and accurate guidance for further actions. Experiments on DynamicGUIBench demonstrate that DynamicUI significantly improves the performance in dynamic GUI environments, while maintaining competitive performance on other public benchmarks.
tldr: This paper introduces DynamicGUIBench, a benchmark for evaluating GUI agents in dynamic environments, and proposes DynamicUI, an agent that uses screen-recording videos and novel frame selection, refinement, and reflection modules to improve performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了用于动态环境评估的GUI智能体基准DynamicGUIBench，并提出了DynamicUI智能体，其使用屏幕录制视频，通过新颖的帧选择、精炼和反思模块来提升性能。

title: Leveraging Previous-Traversal Point Cloud Map Priors for Camera-Based 3D Object Detection and Tracking
summary: Camera-based 3D object detection and tracking are central to autonomous driving, yet precise 3D object localization remains fundamentally constrained by depth ambiguity when no expensive, depth-rich online LiDAR is available at inference. In many deployments, however, vehicles repeatedly traverse the same environments, making static point cloud maps from prior traversals a practical source of geometric priors. We propose DualViewMapDet, a camera-only inference framework that retrieves such map priors online and leverages them to mitigate the absence of a LiDAR sensor during deployment. The key idea is a dual-space camera-map fusion strategy that avoids one-sided view conversion. Specifically, we (i) project the map into perspective view (PV) and encode multi-channel geometric cues to enrich image features and support BEV lifting, and (ii) encode the map directly in bird's-eye view (BEV) with a sparse voxel backbone and fuse it with lifted camera features in a shared metric space. Extensive evaluations on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 demonstrate consistent improvements over strong camera-only baselines, with particularly strong gains in object localization. Ablations further validate the contributions of PV/BEV fusion and prior-map coverage. We make the code and pre-trained models available at https://dualviewmapdet.cs.uni-freiburg.de .
tldr: A camera-based 3D object detection and tracking framework for autonomous driving that leverages static point cloud maps from prior traversals to improve localization accuracy without LiDAR at inference.
tldr_zh: 一种用于自动驾驶的相机三维物体检测与跟踪框架，利用先前遍历得到的静态点云地图作为先验，在无需LiDAR推理的情况下提升定位精度。

title: ASAP: An Azimuth-Priority Strip-Based Search Approach to Planar Microphone Array DOA Estimation in 3D
summary: Direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation is an important task in microphone array processing and many downstream applications. The steered response power with phase transform (SRP-PHAT) method has been widely adopted for DOA estimation in recent years. However, accurate SRP-PHAT estimation in 3D scenarios requires evaluating steering responses over thousands of candidate directions, severely limiting real-time performance on resource-constrained platforms. This challenge becomes even more critical for planar arrays, which are widely used in robotics due to their structural simplicity. Motivated by the fact that azimuth estimation is usually more reliable than elevation estimation for most arrays, we propose ASAP, an azimuth-priority strip-based search approach to planar microphone array DOA estimation in 3D. In the first stage, ASAP performs coarse-to-fine region contraction within azimuthal strips to lock azimuth angles while retaining multiple maxima through spherical caps. In the second stage, it refines elevation along the great-circle arc between two close candidates. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments validate the efficiency and merits of the proposed method over existing approaches.
tldr: A fast DOA estimation method for planar microphone arrays, prioritizing azimuth search for computational efficiency, with relevance to robotics due to the use of planar arrays.
tldr_zh: 一种针对平面麦克风阵列的快速DOA估计方法，优先进行方位角搜索以提高计算效率，与机器人技术相关，因为平面阵列在机器人中应用广泛。

title: ProDrive: Proactive Planning for Autonomous Driving via Ego-Environment Co-Evolution
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving planners typically generate trajectories from current observations alone. However, real-world driving is highly dynamic, and such reactive planning cannot anticipate future scene evolution, often leading to myopic decisions and safety-critical failures. We propose ProDrive, a world-model-based proactive planning framework that enables ego-environment co-evolution for autonomous driving. ProDrive jointly trains a query-centric trajectory planner and a bird's-eye-view (BEV) world model end-to-end: the planner generates diverse candidate trajectories and planning-aware ego tokens, while the world model predicts future scene evolution conditioned on them. By injecting planner features into the world model and evaluating all candidates in parallel, ProDrive preserves end-to-end gradient flow and allows future outcome assessment to directly shape planning. This bidirectional coupling enables proactive planning beyond current-observation-driven decision-making. Experiments on NAVSIM v1 show that ProDrive outperforms strong baselines in both safety and planning efficiency, while ablations validate the effectiveness of the proposed ego-environment coupling design.
tldr: ProDrive is a world-model-based proactive planning framework for autonomous driving that co-evolves ego-vehicle trajectories and environment predictions through a bidirectional, end-to-end trainable planner and world model.
tldr_zh: ProDrive是一个用于自动驾驶的基于世界模型的主动规划框架，它通过一个双向、端到端可训练的规划器和世界模型，协同进化自车轨迹和环境预测。

title: A Scaled Three-Vehicle Platooning Platform
summary: Vehicle platooning has attracted increasing attention as a promising approach to improve traffic efficiency, energy consumption, and roadway safety through coordinated multi-vehicle operation. A key challenge in platooning lies in maintaining stable and accurate path tracking during dynamic maneuvers such as lane changes, where lateral deviations and heading disturbances generated by the lead vehicle may propagate downstream to following vehicles. Robust longitudinal and lateral control systems are therefore essential not only for individual vehicle tracking performance, but also for overall platoon stability. For experimental studies, the Intelligent Mobility and Robotics Lab (IMRL) develops a scaled multi-vehicle platform for autonomous platooning research, with a particular emphasis on cooperative control and human-in-the-loop autonomy. This platform consists of one human-operable lead vehicle and two autonomous followers, enabling controlled and repeatable experiments on leader-follower coordination. Compared with full-scale field testing, this scaled platform offers a safer, lower-cost, and more flexible environment for rapid prototyping, controller validation, and multi-agent autonomy studies, while providing stronger physical realism than purely simulation-based evaluations.
tldr: The paper presents a scaled multi-vehicle platform for autonomous platooning research, focusing on cooperative control, stability, and path tracking during maneuvers, to enable safer and cheaper experimental studies than full-scale testing.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于自动驾驶车队研究的缩放多车平台，专注于协作控制、稳定性和机动过程中的路径跟踪，以提供比全尺寸测试更安全、更经济的实验研究环境。

title: TEACar: An Open-Source Autonomous Driving Platform
summary: Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) increasingly rely on vision-based perception and learning-based control, necessitating experimental platforms that support realistic hardware-in-the-loop validation. Small-scale platforms for autonomous racing offer a practical path to hardware validation, but often suffer from limited modularity, high integration complexity, or restricted extensibility.
